result.title: DynaDFlash: Dynamic Feature Projection for Block Diffusion Speculators
result.comment: Code and trained models available at https://github.com/midas-llm-research/DynaDFlash
result.summary: DFlash trains a parallel draft model on hidden features from its target model. Inspired by the previous work of DFlare that introduced per layer combinations of target hidden states, we test whether context dependent weighting of these states helps improve acceptance length of block diffusion speculators. We trained both a DFlash baseline for the Qwen 3 of block size 16, and a dynamic model that computes gates for each layer to affect the magnitude of hidden features before projection. While mean acceptance length between the dynamic model and the DFlash baseline didn't significantly differ, we notice that the dynamic model excels for drafting in the context of math. In an evaluation of 700 prompts from the MetaMathQA and Orca-Math datasets, the mean accepted length improves by 5%. We also found this lead to a 4.1% higher throughput for a subset of the same dataset in the context of speculative decoding.

AI.brief_summary: 该文在 DFlash 的块扩散投机解码草稿模型基础上，加入按上下文生成的门控，对各层目标模型隐藏特征在投影前做动态加权，并在 Qwen3、块大小 16 上比较接受长度与吞吐，数学语境下略有提升。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「按上下文动态加权各层隐藏状态」的门控机制可供核查是否可用于筛选、组合 latent 推理所需的层间视觉或任务信息，但论文为纯文本投机解码，与 VLM 推理无直接关联。
